h: Shettima leads a Nigerian delegation to Ethiopia to study its nutrition programme
p: Vice President Kashim Shettima is heading a delegation to Ethiopia to learn how the country has tackled malnutrition. Officials say the lessons will be adapted for Nigeria's N774 nutrition drive. The visit is part of efforts to cut child hunger across the country.
more: The delegation includes health and agriculture officials.
The N774 nutrition drive targets every local government area.
Ethiopia is often cited for its community-based feeding model.
